column1: # Hand pronunciations for kabar_core::pron, above the lexicon and the rules.
# Marks: é/è = open e (sore), ê = weak e (besar), ò = Javanese open o,
# â = an a that stays a in Javanese, ' = glottal stop. Plain letters follow the rules.
# Javanese rows come from the accented spellings the lessons used before the
# plain-e decision (2026-10-26); all Javanese stays unverified until reviewed.
